newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen down on economy, foreign sales.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen down on economy, foreign sales.

text.p: Thai stocks would likely decline on Monday on persistent concerns over the Thai economy and foreigners may continue selling to raise baht funds, brokers said.

"Market sentiment is still shaky because investors are worried about the economy. Foreigners may need to sell stocks to raise funds for squaring baht/dollar positions," said Witawus Charuchandr of Ekachart Finance.
The SET index plunged to a new eight-year low on Friday, closing 17.43 points lower at 530.62 on 5.2 billion baht turnover.
The baht last week stood at its 13-year high against the dollar in offshore markets as foreign players scrambled to raise funds to cover short baht positions.
The government halted speculation on the currency by blocking offshore access to the baht.
